The point of this section is to provide a proof of the full parabolic bootstrap for the diffusion in its forward variable in the case $\alpha+\beta-1<1 $.

issues.failure_explanation: In the sharp bootstrap proof, γ<1 and therefore γ>β. The final-time Δ4 term is estimated using only the already known β spatial regularity and the β-Hölder regularity of b. The displayed bound therefore yields at most a factor (|y-y'|∨η)^β, not (|y-y'|∨η)^γ. No cancellation producing the extra γ-β gain is shown.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must either prove a missing final-time cancellation that gives the γ gain or withdraw/weaken the sharp claim to the β regularity already available.
issues.overall_effect: The standalone claim holder-space-gamma_SHARP, namely full γ spatial Hölder regularity when γ<1, is not proved.
issues.title: Sharp appendix spatial Hölder proof jumps from β to γ in final term
issues.why_classification: The primary claim is the sharp γ estimate. The source's proof only supports the lower β exponent, and no complete repair is present, so the advertised bootstrap result does not survive as stated.
